parsing_res_list.block_content: Effective November 1, 1992, for the classifications listed below, evening shift differential shall be $1.45 per hour and night shift differential shall be $1.95 per hour.
Effective November 1, 1992, for the classifications below, the In Lieu of Benefits differential shall be $2.00 per hour.
Cert. Occupational Therapist Asst. I, II
